decisions.reason: The air quality sensor stayed visible only in the initial period and, with a more specific environmental sensing option also in the portfolio, its prospects look too limited to justify keeping this module on the market.
As an upgraded replacement for an existing voltage measurement module, this is a core platform component with clear customer use and low uncertainty about its value.

The MQTT proxy disappeared from the website after launch, which suggests the market test resolved uncertainty quickly and did not justify further commitment even though software is relatively cheap to maintain.
A CAN bus interface fits the firm’s automation and embedded customer base well, and its continued presence indicates enough strategic value to retain it as part of the modular platform.
A dedicated carbon dioxide sensor module has a clear sensing use case, complements the firm’s modular hardware line, and still looks like a worthwhile option to keep open.
The touch panel accessory was no longer mentioned after its launch year, indicating weak revealed demand and making it a good candidate to discontinue.
